hook.name: YinYangHook
hook.description: A hook for a twin ERC-20 token pair (Yin/Yang) that mints or empties token "pieces" on each swap based on the swap direction (buy vs. sell), takes a per-swap skim fee forwarded to a configurable destination (with a 20% sniper tax for the first 10 seconds after pool launch), and bootstraps pool state on first liquidity addition.
